name: sensi-seo-tool
description: Senior Care Local SEO & GEO Evaluation Tool

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sensi/shared && npm run build --workspace @sensi/api && npm run build --workspace @sensi/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist apps/api/dist apps/web/.next
